title: The Last Protocol Again
author: Mirabel Lockridge
blurb: Astrid Villalobos, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
